title: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A figure who touched an old poncho and condensed magic into an Echo, calling forth Abuelo.

entities.name: Abuelo
entities.description: A wise ancestral Echo summoned by Quintorius from an old poncho.

entities.name: Akal Pakal
entities.description: A leader who hopes the lost children of Aclazotz can be reconciled without war.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A being whose 'lost children' are referenced; the Bloodletter of Aclazotz serves it.

entities.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
entities.description: A creature whose presence rips old wounds open to bleed anew.

entities.name: Ghalta
entities.description: A great beast whose thundering roar calls forth a primeval army.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A speaker who once watched a raptor rip a Phyrexian dreadnought in half; Saheeli made a gift for her.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The world beneath whose surface lie caverns and clues to a grand heritage.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: A people who found clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.

entities.name: Samin
entities.description: An Oltec scout wary of a hammerskull dinosaur.

entities.name: Anim Pakal
entities.description: A figure who argues that to protect the world they can no longer hide within it.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer whose single gift for Huatli became a battalion of automatons on Ixalan.

entities.name: Sovereign Okinec Ahau
entities.description: A ruler below the surface who looks hungrily upward as surface empires send explorers down.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate faction whose archaic hat guidelines made some mycoids pirate captains.

entities.name: Tarrian
entities.description: A figure with dark power and hunger, a fragment of which remains in his holy weapon.

entities.name: Tarrian's Soulcleaver
entities.description: Tarrian's holy weapon, which still holds a fragment of his dark power and hunger.

entities.name: Nameless City
entities.description: A place guarded by a sentinel who turns travelers away.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: A faction whose dreadnought was once ripped in half by a raptor.

events.summary: Quintorius touches an old poncho and condenses magic into an Echo, summoning Abuelo.
events.quote: A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

events.summary: The River Heralds discover clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.
events.quote: The River Heralds found clues to a grand heritage below Ixalan's surface.

events.summary: Saheeli's single gift for Huatli grows into a battalion of automatons.
events.quote: What began as a single gift for Huatli became a battalion of automatons unlike anything ever seen on Ixalan.

events.summary: Archaic Brazen Coalition hat guidelines make a few mycoids technically pirate captains.
events.quote: a few mycoids are now technically pirate captains.

relations.quote: A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.
What began as a single gift for Huatli became a battalion of automatons unlike anything ever seen on Ixalan.
Tarrian's holy weapon still holds a fragment of his dark power... and his hunger.
Its very presence rips old wounds open to bleed anew.
